about: Seed data for /meetings/ (newspaper plan item 10). Link to official agendas; never copy agenda text. Recheck schedules every quarter.

bodies.name: Bartholomew County Commissioners

bodies.feed: The county calendar offers 'Download as iCal file' for all repeats. Import that file rather than scraping pages.
